preconditions.description: The number of months n must be between 2 and 500,000.
The length of the income list a must be equal to the ceiling of n divided by 2.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each income value in the list a must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
The income x for the last months must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) if k > 0 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the integer k if a valid k exists, otherwise it must be -1.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a[i:i+k]) > 0 for i in range(n - k + 1))
postconditions.description: For the chosen k, the sum of income for each k consecutive months must be greater than 0.
